final: WITH customer_rep_matches AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) as customer_count FROM Customer c INNER JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_averages AS (SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) as city_avg FROM customer_rep_matches GROUP BY City), filtered_reps AS (SELECT crm.EmployeeId, crm.City, crm.customer_count, ca.city_avg FROM customer_rep_matches crm INNER JOIN city_averages ca ON crm.City = ca.City WHERE crm.customer_count > ca.city_avg), total_matched AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM Customer c INNER JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId), city_summary AS (SELECT fr.City, SUM(fr.customer_count) as total_city_customers, AVG(fr.customer_count - fr.city_avg) as avg_excess, AVG(CAST(fr.customer_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total_count FROM total_matched)) as avg_share FROM filtered_reps fr GROUP BY fr.City) SELECT * FROM city_summary
